title: French Chicken Tagine
description: Inspired by French and Moroccan flavors, this dish features tender chicken in a rich and spicy tagine sauce. Serve with crusty bread for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: tagine spice mix
ingredients.notes: or homemade mix of cinnamon, ginger, cumin, coriander, and cayenne

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the pot. Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tagine spice mix to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Return the chicken to the pot and simmer, covered, until cooked through, about 20-25 minutes.
Serve the chicken and sauce over bread, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
